claimBoundary: isolated Swift kit scenario only; no live ChatGPT revoke, FountainStore receipt, Fountain Press interaction, AX, production issuer, or public release claim
preconditions: fixture owner authentication has explicitly approved one isolated public test client, not the live ChatGPT registration
one issuer, one protected resource, one host.describe scope and exact PKCE S256 redirect are bound
file-backed FountainAuthAuthorityStateStore and a safe grant-evidence ledger are available
the original production ChatGPT client and Hetzner OAuth state remain unchanged

actions.intent: Approve consent, redeem a one-time code and validate host.describe for the isolated client
Owner requests authorization.revoke by the recorded authorizationEventId, without supplying a bearer token
Validate the previously issued access token for the same resource and scope
Reconstruct the issuer and durable state without changing the signing key; validate old token again
Repeat the same revoke event and request an unknown or wrong-issuer event
actions.expected: already-revoked for same event; refused for unknown or wrong issuer

actions.intent: Use a new explicit consent/PKCE authorization event; validate its new token

terminalPredicates: the first authorized host.describe validation succeeds for exactly the isolated client and resource
the first owner revocation returns revoked and the same access token is rejected immediately
token denial survives reopening the file-backed authority state
a duplicate revocation returns already-revoked with no second mutation; unknown and wrong-issuer events refuse
new consent creates a distinct authorizationEventId and restores only the new grant
persisted revocation state and scenario receipts contain no bearer, refresh token, client password, signing key or authorization code
no production client, public Caddy route, Host admission or Fountain Press publication is modified
refusalAndRecovery: anonymous or unauthenticated mutation is rejected at the host adapter before reaching this kit
missing issuance evidence, unknown event, wrong issuer or incomplete state fails closed
restart and duplicate event cannot resurrect an invalidated access token
denial/error does not silently fall back to a different authorization authority

witnesses.kit: Swift XCTest with file-backed authorization state, safe evidence ledger and exact issuer/client/resource predicates
witnesses.midi2: typed revoke and revoke.result contract exists in schema/idl.yaml; external peer exchange not yet witnessed
witnesses.store: file-backed test snapshot only; live FountainStore acceptance not yet established
witnesses.press: consumer AX + rendered browser evidence required after released kit integration, not satisfied by a static preview
witnesses.security: independent live security review not established
